</ul> </nav> <div id="et_mobile_nav_menu"> <div class="mobile_nav closed"> <span class="select_page">Select Page</span> <span class="mobile_menu_bar mobile_menu_bar_toggle"></span> </div> </div> </div> </div> </header> <div id="et-main-area"> <div id="main-content"> <article id="post-2" class="post-2 page type-page status-publish hentry"> <div class="entry-content"> <div class="et-l et-l--post"> <div class="et_builder_inner_content"> <div class="et_pb_section_14 et_pb_section et_pb_fullwidth_section et_section_regular et_block_section et_pb_section_parallax"><span class="et-pb-parallax-wrapper"><span class="et-pb-parallax-background et-pb-parallax-background-module--divi-section-14" style="background-image:url(https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/12/Kite_tribe_banner.jpg)"></span></span><section class="et_pb_fullwidth_header_2 et_pb_fullwidth_header et_pb_fullscreen et_pb_bg_layout_dark et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_module et_flex_module"><div class="et_pb_fullwidth_header_container center"><div class="header-content-container center"><div class="header-content et_flex_module"><h1 class="et_pb_module_header">Kite Tribe – Kitesurfing Experiences in Egypt</h1><span class="et_pb_fullwidth_header_subhead">Kite Safaris, Kite Camps, Professional lessons, walkie-talkie coaching, and a laid-back community vibe – all at the best kite spots on the Red Sea.</span><div class="et_pb_header_button_wrapper"><a class="et_pb_button et_pb_more_button et_pb_button_one" href="https://www.kitetribe.org/kite-safaris-and-camps/">Kite Safaris &amp; Camps</a></div></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_fullwidth_header_overlay"></div><div class="et_pb_fullwidth_header_scroll"></div></section></div><div class="et_pb_section_15 et_pb_section et_section_regular et_block_section"><div class="et_pb_row_28 et_pb_row et_block_row"><div class="et_pb_column_52 et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et-last-child et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_text_34 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2 style="text-align: center;">Kitesurfing focused on experience, not mass tourism</h2>
<h3 style="text-align: center;">Kite Tribe creates thoughtfully designed kitesurfing experiences in Egypt.</h3>
<p style="text-align: center;">From kite safaris on the Red Sea to land-based camps and coaching, we focus on flexibility, safety and time on the water.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">We don’t follow rigid schedules or one-size-fits-all concepts.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Instead, we adapt to wind conditions, group level and the rhythm of nature.</p>
</div></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_row_29 et_pb_row et_block_row"><div class="et_pb_column_53 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_image_8 et_pb_image et_animated et_pb_module et_block_module"><span class="et_pb_image_wrap"><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" src="https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/kite-safari-girls-in-zodiac.jpg" width="1200" height="900" srcset="https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/kite-safari-girls-in-zodiac.jpg 1200w, https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/kite-safari-girls-in-zodiac-980x735.jpg 980w, https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/kite-safari-girls-in-zodiac-480x360.jpg 480w" sizes="(min-width: 0px) and (max-width: 480px) 480px, (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 980px) 980px, (min-width: 981px) 1200px, 100vw" class="wp-image-876" title="kite-safari--girls-in-zodiac" alt="group of 5 girls sitting on the kite beach in El Gouna in Egypt, looking at the kites in the water. The image shows the girls from the back, all wearing a Kite Tribe T-Shirt" / loading="lazy"></span></div></div><div class="et_pb_column_54 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et-last-child et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_text_35 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h3 style="text-align: left;">What Kite Tribe stands for</h3>
<p style="text-align: left;">At Kite Tribe, kitesurfing is more than a sport.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">It’s about freedom, responsibility and community.</p>
<p style="text-align: left;">Our approach:</p>
<ul style="text-align: left;">
<li>Flexible planning based on wind &amp; conditions</li>
<li>Small groups and personal guidance</li>
<li>Clear communication and realistic expectations</li>
<li>Respect for nature, people and local environments</li>
</ul>
<p style="text-align: left;">Whether you join us for a few days or a full kite safari, you become part of a group that values quality over quantity.</p>
</div></div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_button_module_wrapper et_pb_button_10_wrapper"><a class="et_pb_button_10 et_pb_button et_pb_bg_layout_light et_animated et_pb_module et_block_module" href="https://www.kitetribe.org/about-us/">About Kite Tribe</a></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_row_30 et_pb_row et_block_row"><div class="et_pb_column_55 et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et-last-child et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_text_36 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2 style="text-align: center;">What Our Students Say – Top Google Reviews from Happy Riders</h2>
<p style="text-align: center;">We’re proud to have earned the trust of our students from around the world. With 5-star ratings on Google, our kitesurfing and wing foil lessons are known for high-quality instruction, a relaxed and friendly vibe, and real progress on the water. But don’t just take our word for it – read what our Tribe has to say!</p>

class="ti-verified-review ti-verified-platform ti-color-blue"><span class="ti-verified-tooltip">Trustindex verifies that the original source of the review is Google.</span></span></span> <div class="ti-review-text-container ti-review-content">We had an absolutely fantastic time with Kite Tribe in Egypt last week! Everything was perfect from start to finish. The organisation was outstanding, and everything ran so smoothly. The entire team was incredibly friendly, helpful, and professional. No wish was left unfulfilled!
What we particularly loved was the flexibility and personal touch. There were no rigid schedules or fixed routines — everything was tailored to our wishes, making the whole experience feel truly individual and relaxed.
The boat was amazing! The crew was wonderful, the boat was spotlessly clean, and the food was fantastic. We enjoyed a fresh, varied buffet three times a day, with plenty of delicious options.
And of course, the kite spots were absolutely beautiful! Every day was a new highlight, and the whole trip exceeded our expectations.
A huge thank you to the entire Kite Tribe team for creating such an unforgettable experience. We couldn’t have asked for more and would recommend Kite Tribe to anyone looking for an exceptional kite safari in Egypt. We would definitely love to come back!

loading="lazy" alt="" /><div class="ti-more-image-count">+2</div></div>Die Kitesafari mit KiteTribe war einfach rundum genial! Eine Woche auf einem luxuriösen, super sauberen Schiff – besser hätte man es sich kaum vorstellen können. Man hat sich vom ersten Moment an wohlgefühlt. Die Crew war jederzeit da, extrem hilfsbereit und perfekt aufeinander eingespielt – genau so, wie man es sich wünscht.
Ein echtes Highlight waren auch die drei täglichen Mahlzeiten in Buffetform: alles frisch gekocht, unglaublich abwechslungsreich und wirklich sehr fein. Egal ob Frühstück, Mittag- oder Abendessen – immer top Qualität und mit viel Liebe zubereitet.
Die ausgewählten Spots waren perfekt gewählt und das Wetter bzw. der Wind haben die ganze Woche voll mitgespielt. Jede Session hat Spaß gemacht, die Woche war einfach rundum mehr als gelungen.
Das KiteTribe‑Team kenne ich schon länger und auch dieses Mal haben sie wieder absolut abgeliefert. Besonders stark: Es war immer genug Zeit für 1‑zu‑1‑Sessions zwischendrin, wodurch der persönliche Fortschritt nach nur einer Woche richtig spürbar war.
Fazit: Mega Organisation, großartige Crew, traumhafte Spots, hervorragendes Essen und Kiten auf höchstem Niveau. </pre></div></div></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_section_16 et_pb_section et_section_regular et_block_section"><div class="et_pb_row_31 et_pb_row et_block_row"><div class="et_pb_column_56 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_text_37 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_animated et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2><b>Kite Safaris in Egypt</b></h2>
<p>A Kite Safari in Egypt offers maximum flexibility.</p>
<p>Traveling by boat allows us to choose kite locations day by day — depending on wind direction, weather and group dynamics.</p>
<ul>
<li>Live and kite directly from the boat</li>
<li>Daily sessions or no-wind activities</li>
<li>Focus on conditions, not fixed spots</li>
</ul>
<p>Perfect for beginners or independent riders who enjoy variety and a shared experience on board.</p>
<p></p>

et_pb_bg_layout_light et_animated et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2><b>Kitesurf Camps &amp; Coaching</b></h2>
<p>Our kitesurf camps and coaching programs are designed for riders who want to progress in a relaxed and structured way.</p>
<ul>
<li>Suitable for intermediate and advanced kiters</li>
<li>Individual feedback and focused sessions</li>
<li>Safe conditions and experienced instructors</li>
</ul>
<p>Whether you want to refine your technique or simply enjoy consistent sessions, we support you at your own pace.</p>
<p></p>
</div></div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_button_module_wrapper et_pb_button_12_wrapper"><a class="et_pb_button_12 et_pb_button et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module" href="https://www.kitetribe.org/kite-safaris-and-camps/kite-camps/">Discover Kite Camps &amp; Coaching</a></div></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_section_17 et_pb_section et_section_regular et_block_section"><div class="et_pb_row_33 et_pb_row et_block_row"><div class="et_pb_column_60 et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et-last-child et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_text_39 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2 style="text-align: center;"> Why Kite Tribe is your ideal destination for Kitesurfing &amp; Wingfoiling</h2>
</div></div><div class="et_pb_text_40 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p style="text-align: center;">At Kite Tribe, your kitesurfing journey is our priority. Our experienced and certified instructors are passionate about making kitesurfing accessible and enjoyable for everyone. Whether you're taking your first steps onto a board or looking to master advanced techniques, our team is committed to providing a safe, fun, and personalized learning environment.</p>
</div></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_row_34 et_pb_row et_block_row"><div class="et_pb_column_61 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_image_11 et_pb_image et_animated et_pb_module et_block_module"><span class="et_pb_image_wrap"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" src="https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Kite_safari_fun_group-1.jpg" width="1200" height="900" srcset="https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Kite_safari_fun_group-1.jpg 1200w, https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Kite_safari_fun_group-1-980x735.jpg 980w, https://www.kitetribe.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/03/Kite_safari_fun_group-1-480x360.jpg 480w" sizes="(min-width: 0px) and (max-width: 480px) 480px, (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 980px) 980px, (min-width: 981px) 1200px, 100vw" class="wp-image-457" title="Kite_safari_fun_group" alt="group photo on a kitesurfing safari boat" /></span></div></div><div class="et_pb_column_62 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et-last-child et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_text_41 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p style="text-align: center;"><strong>A Community Beyond Kiting</strong></p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Kite Tribe isn't just about kitesurfing; it's about building a community. We're a tribe that celebrates every success, supports through every challenge, and cherishes the memories made along the way. Beyond the lessons and the thrills, we foster a welcoming environment where every member can find a place. #<strong>RideWithTheTribe</strong></p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong></strong></p>
<p style="text-align: center;"><strong>Your Safety, Our Priority</strong></p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Safety is paramount at Kite Tribe. Equipped with the latest gear and adhering to the highest safety standards, we ensure that your learning experience is not only exhilarating but also secure. Our instructors are always on hand to guide you through every step of your journey, offering peace of mind as you explore the joys of kitesurfing.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">

</div></div></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_section_18 et_pb_section et_section_regular et_block_section"><div class="et_pb_row_35 et_pb_row et_pb_row_5col et_block_row et_block_row_5col"><div class="et_pb_column_63 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_5 et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_icon_10 et_pb_icon et_pb_module et_block_module"><span class="et_pb_icon_wrap"><span class="et-pb-icon"></span></span></div><div class="et_pb_text_42 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p style="text-align: center;">Perfect Location</p>
</div></div></div><div class="et_pb_column_64 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_5 et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_icon_11 et_pb_icon et_pb_module et_block_module"><span class="et_pb_icon_wrap"><span class="et-pb-icon"></span></span></div><div class="et_pb_text_43 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p style="text-align: center;">Certified instructors</p>
</div></div></div><div class="et_pb_column_65 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_5 et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_icon_12 et_pb_icon et_pb_module et_block_module"><span class="et_pb_icon_wrap"><span class="et-pb-icon"></span></span></div><div class="et_pb_text_44 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p style="text-align: center;">Personal &amp; Individual</p>
</div></div></div><div class="et_pb_column_66 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_5 et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_icon_13 et_pb_icon et_pb_module et_block_module"><span class="et_pb_icon_wrap"><span class="et-pb-icon"></span></span></div><div class="et_pb_text_45 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p style="text-align: center;">Community &amp; Fun</p>
</div></div></div><div class="et_pb_column_67 et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_5 et-last-child et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_icon_14 et_pb_icon et_pb_module et_block_module"><span class="et_pb_icon_wrap"><span class="et-pb-icon"></span></span></div><div class="et_pb_text_46 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p style="text-align: center;">Focus on Safety</p>
</div></div></div></div><div class="et_pb_row_36 et_pb_row et_block_row"><div class="et_pb_column_68 et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et-last-child et_block_column et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough"><div class="et_pb_text_47 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2 style="text-align: center;">Learn Kitesurfing and Wingfoiling in Egypt with Kite Tribe</h2>
</div></div><div class="et_pb_text_48 et_pb_text et_pb_bg_layout_light et_pb_module et_block_module"><div class="et_pb_text_inner"><p>&nbsp;</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>Beginner Kitesurfing Courses</strong>: Dive into the basics of kitesurfing with our beginner courses. Learn kite handling, safety, and get your first taste of riding the waves under the guidance of our expert instructors.</li>
<li><strong>Advanced Lessons and Private Coaching</strong>: Elevate your skills with advanced lessons tailored to your goals, including jumps, tricks, and hydrofoiling.</li>
<li><strong>Wingfoil Lessons</strong>: Explore the exhilarating world of wingfoiling, a new addition to our diverse range of water sports activities.</li>
<li><strong>Kitesurfing Safaris and More</strong>: Join us on breathtaking kitesurfing safaris around El Gouna, and engage in various fun-filled activities, ensuring your holiday is packed with unforgettable experiences.</li>
</ul>

<p style="text-align: center;">Ready to catch the wind and glide through the water? Kite Tribe welcomes you to Egypt, where the sun shines, the waters beckon, and adventures await at every turn. Whether you're a seasoned kitesurfer or new to the sport, our doors are open to everyone looking to join our growing family.</p>
<p style="text-align: center;">Contact us today to book your kitesurfing course or learn more about our offerings.</p>
